name: Warpline
author: CLVRKE
summary: Wavetable synth for standalone MPC built on the open-source Vital engine: plays .vital patches (add your own banks in <drive>/Warpline/Patches), 300 factory patches with search and favourites, a 16-step arpeggiator, GRAINZ granular FX with five modes and a 16-slot mod matrix.
